    • GameEvent

      public GameEvent​(Urgency urgency, java.lang.String message)
      creates a new event with the given name and a timestamp. This event is automatically added to the #gameEvents queue.
      Parameters:
      urgency - the urgency of the event (determines order in the queue and gives extra information to the receiver)
      message - a message that explains the meaning of this event
